career_spells.evidence_note: July2022 start,2025 state/federal campaign direction; July2025 first speech addresses successors. A public first-person post during the November2023 WA Labor conference states that she took a short break from maternity leave and identifies her son as four months old, establishing leave at that observation but not its start, employment terms or end. Full-time return to work in April2024 is directly self-reported later. Because leave boundaries and the rest of the tenure's working pattern remain unresolved, retain unknown status for the unsplit whole spell. Enterprise agreement representation does not establish a second Perth Trades Hall job. Party describes her as outgoing on30June2025; exact cessation not established, so year-level end retained.

research_notes: 2026-10-01 initial research: official frozen occupations, party employer biography, first speech and WAIRC agreement, public professional index, and later Hansard return-to-work account. Later source used for historical employment evidence without refreshing frozen roster.

No qualifying private/public ordinary employment identified so far, but sources do not establish exhaustive absence. Both headline totals remain unknown, not zero. Political staff, unions and party roles are excluded categories.

Searched named UnionsWA/AMWU historical sources, employer records and explicit full-time language. Most search matches repeated biography or unrelated namesakes. LinkedIn direct access Internal Error; usable indexed month entry retained. PDF find reported no matching text despite accessible opening pages; no inference from missing text.

Follow-up: internship/payroll/host dates and Cook relief job; individual union/staff hours and leave; assistant/state-secretary endpoints and April2024 return/preceding break; university overlap; any earlier paid work. Obtain employment/annual-report evidence rather than treating agreement standard hours as personal proof.

Follow-up 2026-10-02: later penalty-rates Hansard and own speech reproduction identify first Subway job and school/university shift pattern. This supersedes earlier note that no ordinary private employment had been identified. Both totals remain unknown.

Follow-up searches for internship/Cook dates, assistant-secretary appointment and party cessation did not resolve personal hours or payroll endpoints. Public30June2025 party post supplies outgoing-status observation only; exact11July2022 appointment remains an unverified secondary lead until original dated announcement is accessible.

LinkedIn open999, APH Hansard source403 and Instagram Online fetch throttled were individual access gaps; no repeated access-control attempts. Next leads: historical Subway Baldivis franchise/payroll identity and tenure, labour-movement internship records, Cook relief dates, union and party leave/full-time evidence. No employment attributed from other speakers or shared social posts.

Follow-up 2026-10-03: a public first-person LinkedIn post establishes that maternity leave was active at the November2023 WA Labor State Conference, while the already-cited later speech fixes return to full-time work in April2024. The leave start and exact return date remain unknown, so no continuous full-time party tenure is inferred. Searches did not recover new internship/Cook-relief dates or Subway franchise records.
